protocol.five_folds: test fold k, validation fold (k+1)%5, other three train
protocol.mlp_selection: lowest validation MAE; earliest epoch breaks ties
protocol.equal_head_width: zero-pad all input groups to twice the full fused dimension after training-only missing flags/scaling
protocol.secondary_comparison: same input groups with fixed small MLP; standalone and demographic-only increment
protocol.testing_unit: one person, seed-averaged absolute error; no windows as independent observations
protocol.multiple_comparisons: Holm across six pretrained-model fusion increments separately for each of SDS, SBP, DBP; other comparisons exploratory
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 paired person resamples, percentile 95% intervals; fixed split uncertainty not fully represented
protocol.permutation: 100000 paired person sign flips, two-sided; overlapping training folds can induce dependent errors

limitations: Self-reported SDS symptoms, not clinical depression diagnosis
Traditional PRV estimates have no ECG validation
Stimulus timing uses source metadata, not new annotations
interval_interpretation: Exploratory paired person bootstrap; seeds averaged inside people, split is fixed, shared training folds induce dependence
